records.source: UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine / November 17 statement
records.claim: UN mission on November 17 reiterates October 372 killed and 1,981 injured; October coordinated strikes damaged Ukrainian electricity and heat networks and disrupted power and sometimes water. November 2 Komyshuvakha death count is a separate dated event.
records.observation: October violence and infrastructure consequences, not new November 17 damage.
records.assessment: DATED EVIDENCE — DO NOT INFER UNOBSERVED PHYSICAL THROUGHPUT

records.source: UN HRMMU / Protection of Civilians October 2026 (report dated Nov 16)
records.claim: UN monthly report gives October 2026 civilian casualties and increased attacks on electricity/heating infrastructure resulting in power interruptions and planned outages.
records.observation: Report published November 16, follow-up press statement November 17, events in October.
records.assessment: DATED EVIDENCE — DO NOT INFER UNOBSERVED PHYSICAL THROUGHPUT

records.source: Reuters / Nidhi Verma / India awards 2027 US LPG tenders
records.claim: Reuters on Nov 17 reports Indian state firms awarded tender for about 2.75 million tons of US LPG in 2027, split across Saudi Aramco, Chevron, Totsa and Vitol; awards not executed shipment, market sources not issuer notice.
records.observation: Prospective 2027 delivery commitment; India imported 90% of LPG from Middle East in 2025, historical sourcing basis.
records.assessment: DATED EVIDENCE — DO NOT INFER UNOBSERVED PHYSICAL THROUGHPUT
